t.**Create your account.** Sign up on the: Mepụta akaụntụ gị. Jiri adreesị ozi-e na akara ekwentị gị debanye aha na Portal CAC, wee nyochaa ozi-e ahụ. Dee paswọọdụ gị ebe nchekwa.

t.The nature of business tells the public: Ụdị azụmahịa na-agwa ọha na eze na ndị na-achịkwa ihe ị na-eme. Dee ya n'okwu ndị dị mfe dabara n'ihe ị na-ere n'ezie, tinyekwa mmemme nwere njikọ chiri anya ị na-eme atụmatụ n'ime afọ ma ọ bụ abụọ na-abịa. A na-ana ụtụ stampụ n'isi ego n'akwụkwọ ndebanye aha, ya mere isi ego buru ibu na-efu karịa iji debanye aha. Họrọ ọnụ ọgụgụ ị nwere ike izi ezi, ọ bụghị ọnụ ọgụgụ kachasị ukwuu ị nwere ike iche.
